tagline.en: An Apache-2.0 world-action model that predicts a robot's future views and its next moves in one flow process.
tagline.zh: Apache-2.0 许可的世界-动作模型，在同一个 flow 过程里同时预测机器人的未来画面与下一步动作。

en: X-WAM is an open world-action model for robot manipulation. Rather than only predicting an action, a single joint flow process reasons over the robot's future — predicting upcoming RGB frames, depth, proprioception, and the actions to take — so perception and control share one model.

It is built on Alibaba's Wan 2.2 text-image-to-video base and released under Apache-2.0. The default policy returns a chunk of future actions together with predicted proprioception; you can optionally let it continue decoding to render the predicted future views (and depth) as a video mosaic. Post-trained variants are provided for RoboCasa and RoboTwin manipulation settings alongside a pretrained checkpoint.

In WorldFoundry you run X-WAM through its self-contained inference runtime — stage the checkpoint locally, feed the robot's multi-view observation and state, and it returns an action chunk. Turning on world decoding additionally writes out the predicted future-view video.
zh: X-WAM 是一个面向机器人操作的开放世界-动作模型。它不只预测动作，而是用一个联合 flow 过程对机器人的未来做整体推理——同时预测接下来的 RGB 画面、深度、本体感受（proprioception）与要执行的动作，让感知与控制共用一个模型。
它构建在阿里巴巴的 Wan 2.2 图文生视频底座之上，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。默认策略会返回一段未来动作，并附带预测的本体感受；你也可以让它继续解码，把预测出的未来画面（乃至深度）渲染成视频拼图。除预训练 checkpoint 外，还提供了针对 RoboCasa 与 RoboTwin 操作场景的后训练变体。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过 X-WAM 自带的推理运行时来运行它——先把 checkpoint 放到本地，输入机器人的多视角观测与状态，它便返回一段动作。开启世界解码后，还会额外输出预测的未来画面视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a robot policy that also acts as a world model — predicting the near-future scene as it decides actions — with ready post-trained variants for RoboCasa and RoboTwin manipulation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个既是策略、又兼具世界模型能力的机器人模型——在决策动作的同时预测近未来场景——并希望有针对 RoboCasa 与 RoboTwin 操作的现成后训练变体时使用。

notFor.en: Its primary output is an action chunk for robot control, not a video generator for general content. Checkpoints are staged locally, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它的主要输出是用于机器人控制的动作，而非面向通用内容的视频生成器。Checkpoint 需放到本地，请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

en: One flow process predicts future RGB, depth, proprioception, and actions
Post-trained variants for RoboCasa and RoboTwin, plus a pretrained checkpoint
Optional world decoding renders the predicted future views
zh: Apache-2.0 许可，构建于 Wan 2.2 之上
一个 flow 过程同时预测未来 RGB、深度、本体感受与动作
提供 RoboCasa 与 RoboTwin 后训练变体，以及预训练 checkpoint
可选的世界解码能渲染出预测的未来画面
